answer: For a garden economy trading quartz and juniper, remove signup bonuses and pay only for buyer-funded tasks. Each buyer escrows the full reward before assigning work, and agents receive payment only after an independently sampled audit. Creating aliases cannot extract a subsidy: self-dealing merely returns the attacker its own escrow minus fees and audit costs. This blocks profitable signup farming, though it does not prevent fake identities from manipulating votes or dishonest auditors from approving junk.
